segments.narration: This is the actual campaign L capture, continuous at original speed. A transient failure receives retry advice. Automated synthetic quality assurance explicitly approves the permitted retry, and the private verifier confirms a receipt. The next case shows misleading success. segments.name: eval
segments.narration: Separate campaign I evaluated sixteen synthetic cases with actual NVIDIA Lightning. Raw diagnosis and recovery agreement were twelve of sixteen, paired agreement ten. The telemetry comparator scored twelve, ten, and eight. Two model diagnoses were wrong at high confidence. A later consumed output replay accepted nine, abstained on four, and required review on three. Displayed paired agreement fell to six. This was post hoc adaptation, not fresh validation. Dataset authorship and labels visible review used AI agents, not external experts.

segments.name: failures
segments.narration: Failures remain part of the record. In campaign F, the model wrongly recommended retry after misleading success. The private guard blocked it. Alternate model campaigns G and H failed structured output or returned an HTTP five hundred; unknown usage remains conservatively reserved. Campaign K stopped before diagnoses because its capture helper expected an old path. L corrected that capture. Earlier form comparisons found no completion rate advantage over competent DOM automation.
